summary: The southern commanderies have risen. Zhuge Liang leads the army south himself, taking Ma Su's advice that winning hearts matters more than winning cities.
summary_zh: 南中诸郡叛乱，诸葛亮亲率大军南征。参军马谡建议“攻心为上，攻城为下”，诸葛亮采纳了这一方略。

title: Meng Huo captured the first time
summary: Meng Huo is lured into an ambush and captured. He says he was simply caught off guard; Zhuge Liang lets him go to try again. Historically: the 'seven captures and seven releases' come from the Han-Jin chunqiu cited in the notes; the details of each are the novel's.
summary_zh: 孟获中了埋伏被擒，说是一时疏忽，不服。诸葛亮放他回去再战。史实：“七擒七纵”见于裴注引《汉晋春秋》，具体经过出自小说。

title: Crossing the Lu River in the fifth month
summary: In summer heat the army crosses the Lu, whose waters are said to be poisonous by day, and Meng Huo is captured a second time. Historically: 'In the fifth month I crossed the Lu and went deep into barren land' is Zhuge Liang's own line in his memorial; the second capture belongs to the seven.
summary_zh: 盛夏时节大军渡过泸水，据说白天水中有瘴毒。孟获第二次被擒。史实：“五月渡泸，深入不毛”是诸葛亮在《出师表》中的原话；第二次擒获属于七擒故事。

title: Meng Huo's false surrender, the third capture
summary: Meng Huo's brother comes with gifts to surrender, Meng Huo planning to strike in the confusion; Zhuge Liang gets the brother's men drunk and takes Meng Huo a third time. Historically: the details are the novel's.
summary_zh: 孟获派弟弟孟优带礼物诈降，想里应外合。诸葛亮将计就计，灌醉孟优部众，第三次擒住孟获。史实：具体经过出自小说。

title: The poisoned springs of Bald Dragon Cave
summary: In the far south the soldiers drink from springs that strike them dumb or kill them; a hermit, brother of the rebel king, gives them a herb to cure it. Historically: there is no record of it; the springs and the herb are the novel's.
summary_zh: 大军深入南方，士兵误饮哑泉，失声或身亡。孟获之兄孟节隐居山中，以薤叶芸香相救。史实：并无记载，哑泉与解药都是小说情节。

title: The fifth capture
summary: Even with the poisoned springs and the help of King Duosi, Meng Huo is betrayed by his own allies and delivered to Zhuge Liang a fifth time. Historically: the details are the novel's.
summary_zh: 孟获借毒泉和朵思大王之助，仍被部下杨锋等人缚送蜀营，第五次被擒。史实：具体经过出自小说。

title: Meng Huo captured seven times
summary: Seven times Zhuge Liang captures the southern leader Meng Huo and six times lets him go, until Meng Huo swears the south will never rebel again. Historically: the 'seven captures and seven releases' appear in the Han-Jin chunqiu cited in the notes, not in the Records itself, and many historians doubt the number; the south did in fact rebel again within a few years.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮七次擒获南中首领孟获，六次释放，孟获终于心服，发誓“南人不复反矣”。史实：“七纵七禽”见于裴注引《汉晋春秋》，陈寿《三国志》正文并无记载，史家多怀疑这个次数；而且南中此后几年内仍有反叛。

title: Burning the rattan-armoured army
summary: The king of Wuge brings warriors in rattan armour soaked in oil, which arrows cannot pierce. Zhuge Liang lures them into Panshe Valley and burns thirty thousand, and weeps that he will be punished in heaven for it. Historically: neither the kingdom nor the battle is recorded.
summary_zh: 乌戈国王兀突骨率藤甲兵来援，藤甲浸油，刀箭不入。诸葛亮诱其入盘蛇谷，火烧三万藤甲兵，事后流泪说自己必损阳寿。史实：乌戈国和此战均不见于史书。

title: Wooden beasts against wild beasts
summary: King Mulu rides an elephant and drives tigers, leopards and wolves at the Shu army. Zhuge Liang answers with painted wooden beasts that breathe fire and smoke, and the real ones turn and flee: the sixth capture. Historically: invented.
summary_zh: 木鹿大王骑白象、驱虎豹豺狼冲阵。诸葛亮造木刻彩绘的巨兽，口吐烟火，真兽反被吓退，第六次擒孟获。史实：并无此事。

title: Offering 'heads' at the Lu River
summary: The river spirits demand forty-nine human heads before the army can cross home. Zhuge Liang has dough shaped into heads stuffed with meat and offers those instead: the novel's story of how mantou, steamed buns, were invented. Historically: a legend; the name is first explained this way in a Song dynasty book.
summary_zh: 回师至泸水，狂风大作，当地习俗要以四十九颗人头祭河神。诸葛亮命人以面裹肉，做成人头模样代替祭祀，号为“馒头”。史实：这是传说，最早见于宋代的《事物纪原》。

title: The memorial on the eve of the campaign
summary: Before leaving for the north, Zhuge Liang submits his memorial to the young emperor: the realm is in three, Yizhou is weary, this is a time of mortal danger; keep worthy men close and petty men away; I was a commoner ploughing in Nanyang when the late emperor visited me three times. The text is in the Records, and it is still learned by heart in Chinese schools.
summary_zh: 北伐出师前，诸葛亮向后主上表：“今天下三分，益州疲弊，此诚危急存亡之秋也。”劝他亲贤臣、远小人，又追述“臣本布衣，躬耕于南阳……先帝不以臣卑鄙，猥自枉屈，三顾臣于草庐之中”。全文载于《三国志·诸葛亮传》，至今仍是中学课文。

title: Zhao Yun, seventy, kills five generals
summary: On the first northern expedition the old Zhao Yun kills five Wei generals in one day. Historically: Zhao Yun commanded the decoy force at Ji Valley, was beaten by superior numbers, and kept his army together in retreat; no generals died at his hand.
summary_zh: 第一次北伐，年过七旬的赵云一日之内连斩魏将五员。史实：赵云率疑兵出箕谷，因兵弱敌强而失利，但收拢部众固守，没有大败；并无斩将之事。

title: Three commanderies go over to Shu
place_zh: 天水郡冀县（今甘肃甘谷）
summary: As Zhuge Liang marches out through Qishan, the commanderies of Nan'an, Tianshui and Anding rise against Wei and declare for him. Guanzhong is in panic.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮出祁山，南安、天水、安定三郡叛魏响应，关中震动。

title: Zhuge Liang curses Wang Lang to death
summary: Between the lines the seventy-six-year-old Wei minister Wang Lang tries to argue Zhuge Liang into surrender; Zhuge Liang calls him a grey-bearded traitor and he falls dead from his horse. Historically: Wang Lang died of illness in Luoyang in 228 and never went near the front.
summary_zh: 七十六岁的魏国司徒王朗在两军阵前劝诸葛亮投降，被诸葛亮痛骂为“皓首匹夫，苍髯老贼”，气得撞死马下。史实：王朗228年病逝于洛阳，从未到过前线。

title: Jiang Wei comes over
summary: The young Tianshui officer Jiang Wei, distrusted by his own governor and shut out of his city, goes over to Zhuge Liang, who soon calls him the best man in Liang province. He will carry on the war after Zhuge Liang's death.
summary_zh: 天水郡年轻将领姜维被太守猜疑，进不了城，只得投奔诸葛亮。诸葛亮称赞他是“凉州上士”。诸葛亮死后，正是他继续北伐。

title: Sima Yi crushes Meng Da
summary: Meng Da, who had gone over to Wei, plans to come back to Shu. Sima Yi does not wait for orders: he covers twelve hundred li in eight days, takes the city in sixteen and beheads him.
summary_zh: 降魏的孟达密谋反正归蜀。司马懿不待奏报，八日行军一千二百里，围城十六日破之，斩孟达。

title: Zhuge Liang beats the Qiang in the snow
summary: Wei calls in a Qiang army with iron-clad war carts. Zhuge Liang waits for snow, has pits dug and covered, and the heavy carts pitch into them. Historically: invented.
summary_zh: 魏国请来西羌兵助战，羌兵有铁车阵。诸葛亮等大雪降下，在雪地里挖坑设伏，铁车纷纷陷落。史实：并无此事。

title: Ma Su loses Jieting
summary: Given the key pass at Jieting, Ma Su ignores his orders and his deputy Wang Ping, leaves the road and the water, and camps on the hill. Zhang He cuts off his water and routs him, and the whole campaign collapses.
summary_zh: 马谡奉命守街亭，违背诸葛亮的部署，也不听副将王平劝阻，舍弃水源和要道，屯兵山上。张郃断其汲水之道，大破蜀军，第一次北伐功败垂成。

title: The empty fort
summary: With only a few thousand men in Xicheng and Sima Yi's army arriving, Zhuge Liang opens the gates, has old soldiers sweep the road, and sits on the wall playing the zither. Sima Yi, knowing him too careful to take such a risk, suspects a trap and withdraws. Historically: the story comes from Guo Chong's anecdotes in the notes, and Pei Songzhi himself refuted it: Sima Yi was then stationed far away in Jingzhou. The real empty-gate trick was Zhao Yun's on the Han River in 219.
summary_zh: 西城只剩两千五百老弱，司马懿十五万大军将至。诸葛亮大开城门，令老军洒扫街道，自己在城楼上焚香抚琴。司马懿知他一生谨慎，疑有埋伏，引兵退去。史实：此事出自裴注所引郭冲所述，裴松之当即驳斥，指出司马懿当时远在荆州宛城。真正的“空营计”是219年赵云在汉水所用。

title: Zhuge Liang executes Ma Su in tears
summary: Zhuge Liang has Ma Su executed for the loss of Jieting, weeping, and asks to be demoted three grades himself for having chosen him. Liu Bei had warned him that Ma Su's words outran his ability.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮依军法斩了马谡，挥泪不止，又上表自贬三等，承担用人不当之责。刘备生前曾告诫他：马谡言过其实，不可大用。

title: Zhou Fang cuts his hair to trap Cao Xiu
summary: To convince Wei that his defection is real, the Wu governor Zhou Fang cuts off his hair in front of the envoys. Cao Xiu marches deep into Wu to receive him and Lu Xun crushes him at Shiting.
summary_zh: 东吴鄱阳太守周鲂诈降，为取信于魏，当着使者的面剪下头发谢罪。曹休率军深入接应，在石亭被陆逊大败。

title: Zhao Yun dies
summary: As Zhuge Liang prepares to march again, word comes that Zhao Yun has died. Zhuge Liang stamps and weeps that he has lost an arm. Historically: Zhao Yun died in 229, a year later than the novel has it; Liu Bei's praise, 'courage from head to foot', is from the Zhao Yun biezhuan.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮正准备再次北伐，传来赵云病故的消息，诸葛亮跌足痛哭，说“国家损一栋梁，吾去一臂也”。史实：赵云卒于229年，比小说晚一年；刘备称赞他“一身都是胆”，见于裴注引《赵云别传》。

title: The second memorial
summary: Zhuge Liang submits a second memorial before marching again, ending: I shall bend my back to the task until death. Historically: the 'Later Memorial' is not in Zhuge Liang's collected works and is known only from a later copy cited in the notes; its authenticity has been argued over for centuries.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮再次北伐前又上一表，末句为“鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已”。史实：《后出师表》不见于《诸葛亮集》，只靠裴注引张俨《默记》流传下来，其真伪千百年来争论不休。

title: Jiang Wei's false letter to Cao Zhen
summary: Jiang Wei sends Cao Zhen a secret letter offering to come back to Wei and open the Shu lines; Cao Zhen marches to meet him and into an ambush. Historically: invented.
summary_zh: 姜维写密信给曹真，诈称愿意反正归魏、里应外合。曹真信以为真，领兵接应，中了埋伏。史实：并无此事。

title: Zhuge Liang takes Chencang
summary: Zhuge Liang besieges Chencang, and in the novel takes it after its defender Hao Zhao falls ill. Historically: Hao Zhao held Chencang with a thousand men against every siege engine Zhuge Liang had for over twenty days, and Zhuge Liang withdrew when his food ran out.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮围攻陈仓，小说写守将郝昭病重时诸葛亮破城。史实：郝昭以千余人坚守陈仓，诸葛亮云梯、冲车、地道轮番进攻二十余日不能下，粮尽退兵。

title: Wang Shuang is killed in the pursuit
summary: As Shu pulls back from Chencang, the Wei cavalry officer Wang Shuang gives chase and is killed. The Records names him.
summary_zh: 蜀军从陈仓撤退，魏将王双率骑兵追击，被诸葛亮击斩。《三国志·诸葛亮传》记有其名。

title: Sun Quan proclaims himself emperor
summary: Sun Quan takes the title of emperor at Wuchang and soon moves his capital to Jianye. Shu, rather than break the alliance, sends congratulations: now there are three emperors.
summary_zh: 孙权在武昌即皇帝位，不久迁都建业。蜀汉为保全联盟，遣使祝贺。至此三国皆已称帝。

title: Shu takes Wudu and Yinping
summary: On the third expedition Chen Shi takes Wudu and Yinping, and Zhuge Liang drives off the Wei relief army. The only lasting territorial gain of all the northern campaigns.
summary_zh: 第三次北伐，陈式攻取武都、阴平二郡，诸葛亮击退魏国援军。这是历次北伐中唯一长期守住的战果。

title: Wei invades Shu by three roads
summary: Wei strikes back: Cao Zhen through the Ziwu Valley, Zhang He through the Xie Valley, Sima Yi up the Han River from Wan. Thirty days of rain end it before the armies meet.
summary_zh: 魏国三路伐蜀：曹真出子午谷，张郃出斜谷，司马懿从宛城溯汉水西上。连降三十多天大雨，各路未及交战便撤回。

title: Cao Zhen's invasion is drowned in rain
summary: Wei invades Shu by three roads; the rain falls for thirty days, the roads wash out, and the armies turn back. In the novel Zhuge Liang then writes Cao Zhen a mocking letter that kills him with rage. Historically: the rains and the retreat are recorded; Cao Zhen died of illness the next year.
summary_zh: 曹真等率魏军三路伐蜀，连降大雨三十余日，栈道断绝，只得撤兵。小说又写诸葛亮致书羞辱曹真，将他活活气死。史实：大雨退兵有记载；曹真是次年病逝的。

title: Zhuge Liang humiliates Sima Yi in a contest of formations
summary: Sima Yi challenges Zhuge Liang to a contest of battle formations. Zhuge Liang names each of Sima Yi's at a glance, then lays out his own Eight Trigrams formation, and Sima Yi's officers go in and are captured. Historically: invented.
summary_zh: 司马懿与诸葛亮斗阵法，诸葛亮一眼识破对方阵名，又摆出八卦阵，魏将闯入阵中纷纷被擒。史实：并无此事。

title: Zhang He is killed at Mumen
place_zh: 木门道（今甘肃天水西南）
summary: Ordered by Sima Yi to pursue the retreating Shu army against his own judgement, the veteran Zhang He is ambushed at Mumen and killed by an arrow in the knee.
summary_zh: 司马懿令张郃追击撤退的蜀军，张郃认为不宜追击而被迫出兵，在木门道遭蜀军伏击，右膝中箭身亡。

title: Reaping Wei's wheat at Shanggui
summary: Short of food, Zhuge Liang harvests the Wei wheat at Shanggui while his men, dressed as spirits, frighten Sima Yi's scouts. Historically: the wheat harvest at Shanggui is recorded; the disguises are the novel's.
summary_zh: 蜀军缺粮，诸葛亮到上邽抢割魏国麦子，又让士兵扮作天神，吓退司马懿的探马。史实：上邽割麦有记载，装神弄鬼是小说情节。

title: Wooden oxen and gliding horses
summary: To carry grain over the mountain roads Zhuge Liang builds the 'wooden ox' and 'gliding horse', and later tricks Sima Yi with ones that stop when a hidden tongue is twisted. Historically: the transport machines are recorded, used in 231 and 234; how they worked is unknown. The trick is the novel's.
summary_zh: 为在蜀道运粮，诸葛亮造木牛流马；小说又写他让司马懿仿造，再扭转牛舌使其不能行动，劫走魏粮。史实：木牛、流马见于《三国志·诸葛亮传》，分别用于231年和234年，构造早已失传；扭舌劫粮出自小说。

title: Guo Huai holds the northern plain
summary: Guo Huai sees that if Zhuge Liang crosses the Wei and takes the northern plain he can cut the road to the west, and seizes it first. The campaign settles into a stalemate across the river.
summary_zh: 郭淮看出诸葛亮若渡渭水占据北原，就能隔断陇右通道，抢先屯兵北原。两军从此隔着渭水对峙。

title: Sima Yi trapped by fire in Shangfang Valley
summary: Zhuge Liang lures Sima Yi and his sons into a valley and sets it alight; a sudden downpour puts out the fire and they escape. Zhuge Liang sighs: man proposes, heaven disposes. Historically: there is no record of it.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮诱司马懿父子进入上方谷，四面火起，眼看全军覆没，忽然天降大雨浇灭大火，司马懿得以逃脱。诸葛亮叹道：“谋事在人，成事在天。”史实：并无此事记载。

title: Zhuge Liang prays to the stars for more life
summary: Falling ill, Zhuge Liang lights forty-nine lamps around his tent to pray for twelve more years; if the main lamp stays lit for seven days he will live. On the sixth night Wei Yan bursts in and knocks it out. Historically: invented.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮病重，在帐中点四十九盏灯祈禳北斗，若主灯七日不灭，可延寿一纪。第六夜魏延闯入帐中报信，扑灭了主灯。史实：并无此事。

title: The star falls at Wuzhang Plains
summary: After a hundred days facing Sima Yi across the Wei River, Zhuge Liang dies in camp at fifty-four. The army withdraws in good order, and when Sima Yi pursues and the Shu banners turn to face him, he flees: the people said 'a dead Zhuge put a living Zhongda to flight'. The saying is recorded in the Han-Jin chunqiu.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮与司马懿在渭水相持百余日，病逝于五丈原军中，年五十四岁。蜀军有序撤退，司马懿追来，蜀军反旗鸣鼓作势迎战，司马懿急忙退走。百姓编出谚语：“死诸葛走生仲达。”此语见于裴注引《汉晋春秋》。

title: A wooden statue puts Sima Yi to flight
summary: Sima Yi pursues the retreating Shu army; it turns, and in the middle sits Zhuge Liang in his carriage. Sima Yi flees, feeling for his head. It was a wooden statue. Historically: the Han-Jin chunqiu says the Shu army turned its banners and beat its drums, and Sima Yi fell back; the statue is the novel's.
summary_zh: 司马懿追击撤退的蜀军，蜀军忽然回旗返鼓，中间推出诸葛亮端坐车上。司马懿大惊而逃，一路摸着脑袋问“吾有头否”。那是一尊木像。史实：裴注引《汉晋春秋》载蜀军反旗鸣鼓作势，司马懿退走；木像出自小说。

title: 'Who dares kill me?' Wei Yan dies
place: Hanzhong, the mouth of the Bao Valley
summary: Wei Yan refuses to retreat under Yang Yi and turns on him. Riding out, he shouts three times 'who dares kill me?', and Ma Dai, following Zhuge Liang's sealed instructions, answers 'I dare!' and cuts him down. Historically: Wei Yan's feud with Yang Yi, his burning of the plank roads and his death at Ma Dai's hands are recorded; the sealed bag and the shout are the novel's. Chen Shou thought Wei Yan meant to fight Yang Yi, not to defect.
summary_zh: 魏延不服杨仪统领，率部烧断栈道相攻。他在阵前连喊三声“谁敢杀我”，马岱依诸葛亮锦囊之计应声“吾敢杀汝”，一刀斩之。史实：魏延与杨仪相争、烧绝栈道、被马岱追斩都有记载；锦囊与喊话出自小说。陈寿认为魏延只是想除掉杨仪，并无投魏之意。

title: The emperor tries to move the bronze dew plate
summary: The Wei emperor Cao Rui orders the Han emperor Wu's bronze immortal holding a plate to catch heavenly dew moved from Chang'an to Luoyang. The plate breaks, the statue is too heavy to move, and it is said to have wept. The Weilüe cited in the notes records the attempt.
summary_zh: 魏明帝曹叡下令把汉武帝在长安所铸的承露铜人和承露盘搬到洛阳。承露盘折断，铜人太重运不动，相传铜人潸然泪下。裴注所引《魏略》记有此事。

title: Sima Yi destroys Gongsun Yuan
summary: The Liaodong warlord Gongsun Yuan proclaims himself king. Sima Yi marches four thousand li, waits out the summer rains, takes Xiangping and kills him and every man over fifteen in the city.
summary_zh: 辽东公孙渊自立为燕王。司马懿远征四千里，熬过夏季大雨，攻破襄平，斩公孙渊，屠杀城中十五岁以上男子七千余人。

title: Sima Yi feigns senility
summary: Pushed aside by the regent Cao Shuang, Sima Yi receives Cao Shuang's man Li Sheng in bed, mishears every word, and dribbles porridge down his chest. Li Sheng reports that the old man is finished. The scene is in the Book of Jin.
summary_zh: 司马懿被大将军曹爽架空，曹爽心腹李胜来探病，司马懿装作耳聋糊涂，喝粥时汤水流满前襟。李胜回报说司马懿已不足为虑。此事载于《晋书·宣帝纪》。

title: The coup at Gaoping tomb
summary: When Cao Shuang takes the young emperor out of the city to visit the imperial tomb, Sima Yi seizes Luoyang. Promised his life and fortune, Cao Shuang gives up; he and his family are executed days later. From now on Wei belongs to the Sima.
summary_zh: 曹爽陪少帝曹芳出城拜谒高平陵，司马懿趁机关闭城门，控制洛阳。曹爽得到保全性命的承诺后交出兵权，数日后即被夷灭三族。从此魏国大权归于司马氏。

title: Jiang Wei is beaten at Niutou Mountain
place_zh: 牛头山（今甘肃岷县一带）
summary: Jiang Wei's first independent campaign into Yong province ends when Guo Huai cuts his road back at Niutou Mountain.
summary_zh: 姜维首次独立北伐雍州，被郭淮在牛头山截断退路，无功而返。

title: Ding Feng fights in the snow at Dongxing
summary: Wei attacks the Wu dyke at Dongxing in winter. Ding Feng has his three thousand men strip off their armour and attack in the snow with only short weapons; the Wei officers, drinking in their camp, are routed. The Records tells it.
summary_zh: 魏军冬季进攻东兴堤，东吴老将丁奉令三千士兵脱去铠甲，只持短刀盾牌冒雪冲锋，正在饮酒的魏军大败。《三国志·丁奉传》有载。

title: Sun Jun kills Zhuge Ke at a banquet
summary: Zhuge Ke, the Wu regent and Zhuge Liang's nephew, comes back from a disastrous campaign and is murdered at a palace banquet by Sun Jun.
summary_zh: 东吴权臣诸葛恪（诸葛亮之侄、诸葛瑾之子）北伐新城大败而归，在宫中宴席上被孙峻伏兵杀死。

title: Jiang Wei traps Sima Zhao on Iron Cage Mountain
summary: Jiang Wei traps Sima Zhao on a waterless mountain; Sima Zhao prays and a spring gushes out, and he is rescued. Historically: invented.
summary_zh: 姜维把司马昭围困在缺水的铁笼山上，司马昭拜泉求水，泉水涌出，后被救出。史实：并无此事。

title: Sima Shi deposes the emperor
summary: After a plot against him is discovered, Sima Shi deposes the emperor Cao Fang and puts the young Cao Mao on the throne. The novel calls it Wei's retribution for what it did to the Han.
summary_zh: 大臣谋诛司马师事泄，司马师废黜魏帝曹芳，改立曹髦。小说称之为魏家篡汉的“果报”。

title: Jiang Wei's victory west of the Tao
summary: Jiang Wei wins his greatest victory, killing tens of thousands of Wei soldiers on the Tao River, and besieges Didao, but has to fall back when relief comes.
summary_zh: 姜维在洮水西岸大破魏军，斩杀数万人，这是他北伐中最大的一次胜利，随后围攻狄道，因魏援军赶到而撤退。

title: Wen Yang charges alone
summary: In the rising of Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin, Wen Qin's eighteen-year-old son Wen Yang charges Sima Shi's army alone again and again. Sima Shi, recovering from an eye operation, is so shaken that his eye bursts; he dies soon after.
summary_zh: 毌丘俭、文钦起兵讨司马师。文钦之子、年仅十八岁的文鸯单骑数次冲入司马师大营。司马师刚割过眼瘤，受惊之下眼珠迸出，不久病死。

title: Deng Ai defeats Jiang Wei at Duangu
summary: Deng Ai anticipates Jiang Wei's route and destroys his army at Duangu; Shu's strength never recovers.
summary_zh: 邓艾预判姜维进军路线，在段谷大破蜀军，蜀汉元气大伤，从此一蹶不振。

title: Zhuge Dan rises at Shouchun
summary: Zhuge Dan, governor in the east and a kinsman of Zhuge Liang, rises against Sima Zhao with Wu's help. Sima Zhao besieges Shouchun with the emperor and the empress dowager in his train, so that no one can act behind his back.
summary_zh: 镇东大将军诸葛诞在寿春起兵讨伐司马昭，东吴派兵援助。司马昭挟持皇帝和太后随军亲征，防止后方生变，率大军围攻寿春。

title: Jiang Wei marches through the Luo Valley
summary: While Wei is busy with Zhuge Dan's rising, Jiang Wei comes out through the Luo Valley to the grain stores at Changcheng, but Sima Wang and Deng Ai hold firm and he withdraws.
summary_zh: 趁魏国忙于平定诸葛诞，姜维出骆谷，直逼长城囤粮处，司马望、邓艾坚守不战，姜维只得撤回。

title: Shouchun falls; Zhuge Dan's men die rather than surrender
summary: After a year's siege Shouchun falls. Zhuge Dan is killed; several hundred of his personal guard refuse to surrender and are beheaded one by one, each saying he would die for Lord Zhuge. The Wu officer Yu Quan dies fighting rather than flee.
summary_zh: 围城一年后寿春陷落，诸葛诞被杀。他的数百名亲兵拒不投降，排队受斩，每杀一人都问降不降，无一人投降，都说“为诸葛公死，不恨”。吴将于诠也力战而死。

title: Sun Xiu destroys the regent Sun Chen
summary: The Wu emperor Sun Xiu, put on the throne by the overbearing regent Sun Chen, has Ding Feng and Zhang Bu arrest him at the winter festival banquet, and he is executed.
summary_zh: 吴帝孙休被权臣孙綝扶上皇位，与丁奉、张布定计，在腊会宴上擒杀孙綝。

title: Jiang Wei outwits Deng Ai at formations
summary: Deng Ai challenges Jiang Wei to a contest of formations and Jiang Wei, who learned from Zhuge Liang, wins it. Historically: invented.
summary_zh: 邓艾与姜维斗阵，姜维得诸葛亮真传，以八阵之法取胜。史实：并无此事。

title: Cao Mao rides out to die
summary: 'Sima Zhao's heart is known to every man in the street', says the nineteen-year-old emperor Cao Mao, and leads a few hundred palace servants out to attack him. One of Sima Zhao's officers runs him through with a spear in the street. The saying is in the Han-Jin chunqiu.
summary_zh: 十九岁的魏帝曹髦说“司马昭之心，路人所知也”，亲率宫中数百僮仆出宫讨伐司马昭，在南阙下被司马昭部下成济一戈刺穿胸膛而死。这句话见于裴注引《汉晋春秋》。

title: Jiang Wei baits Wei with abandoned grain
summary: Jiang Wei leaves a train of grain carts as bait; the Wei troops rush to seize it and are cut to pieces. Historically: invented.
summary_zh: 姜维故意丢弃粮车，魏军争抢粮草，被伏兵冲杀。史实：并无此事。

title: Jiang Wei farms at Tazhong
summary: With the eunuch Huang Hao in favour at court and his own campaigns blamed for Shu's exhaustion, Jiang Wei withdraws to farm with his army at Tazhong, far from Chengdu.
summary_zh: 宦官黄皓得宠专权，姜维屡次北伐也遭朝臣非议。他为避祸，率军到远离成都的沓中屯田。

title: The eunuch Huang Hao and the recall of Jiang Wei
summary: The eunuch Huang Hao runs the court. Jiang Wei asks Liu Shan to execute him; Liu Shan refuses, and Jiang Wei, fearing for himself, takes his army off to farm at Tazhong. Jiang Wei's biography records it.
summary_zh: 宦官黄皓专权，姜维奏请后主诛杀黄皓，后主不许。姜维怕遭陷害，率军到沓中屯田避祸。见于《三国志·姜维传》。

title: Zhong Hui invades Shu through Hanzhong
summary: Sima Zhao sends three armies against Shu. Zhong Hui pours through Hanzhong with a hundred thousand men, and on the way pays his respects at Zhuge Liang's tomb on Mount Dingjun, forbidding his soldiers to cut wood near it. The novel has Zhuge Liang's ghost appear to him there.
summary_zh: 司马昭三路伐蜀，钟会率十余万大军经汉中南下，途中到定军山祭拜诸葛亮墓，下令士兵不得在墓旁砍柴放牧。小说又写诸葛亮在此显圣，嘱他勿伤百姓。

title: Zhuge Liang's ghost appears on Mount Dingjun
summary: Zhong Hui, offering sacrifice at Zhuge Liang's tomb, sees the ghost of the chancellor, who asks him to spare the people of Shu. Historically: Zhong Hui did sacrifice at the tomb and forbade his soldiers to cut wood near it; the ghost is the novel's.
summary_zh: 钟会到定军山诸葛亮墓前祭拜，忽见武侯显圣，嘱他入川后勿伤百姓。史实：钟会确曾祭拜诸葛亮墓，并下令士兵不得在墓旁砍柴放牧；显圣出自小说。

title: Deng Ai crosses the Yinping wilderness
place_zh: 阴平道摩天岭（今甘肃文县、四川青川之间）
summary: With Jiang Wei holding Zhong Hui at Jiange, Deng Ai takes a column through seven hundred li of roadless mountains, cutting paths and bridging gorges; at one cliff he wraps himself in a felt blanket and rolls down. The Records tells it.
summary_zh: 姜维在剑阁挡住钟会，邓艾率偏师从阴平小道穿越七百余里无人山区，凿山开路、架桥过涧，到了险绝之处，邓艾用毛毡裹住身体，翻滚而下。《三国志·邓艾传》有载。

title: Zhuge Zhan dies at Mianzhu
summary: Zhuge Liang's son Zhuge Zhan and grandson Zhuge Shang refuse Deng Ai's offer to make them kings and die fighting at Mianzhu, the last army between Deng Ai and Chengdu.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮之子诸葛瞻、孙诸葛尚拒绝邓艾封王的劝降，在绵竹力战而死。这是邓艾与成都之间的最后一道防线。

title: Liu Shan surrenders; Liu Chen dies in the ancestral temple
summary: Liu Shan surrenders to Deng Ai. His son Liu Chen, Prince of Beidi, who wanted to fight to the last, goes to Liu Bei's temple, kills his wife and children and then himself. The Han-Jin chunqiu records it.
summary_zh: 后主刘禅出城向邓艾投降。其子北地王刘谌主张背城一战，劝阻不成，到昭烈庙中痛哭，先杀妻儿，然后自杀。此事见于裴注引《汉晋春秋》。

title: Deng Ai is carried off in a prison cart
summary: Deng Ai, conqueror of Shu, behaves as if he were its king; Zhong Hui, jealous, reports him as a rebel, and Deng Ai is arrested and sent east in a cage cart. Recorded in both men's biographies.
summary_zh: 灭蜀首功的邓艾在成都承制拜官，有些专擅；钟会忌其功劳，诬告他谋反，邓艾被收捕，装入槛车押往洛阳。见于《三国志》邓艾、钟会传。

title: Jiang Wei's false surrender and Zhong Hui's revolt
summary: Jiang Wei surrenders to Zhong Hui and urges him to rebel against Sima Zhao, meaning to kill him afterwards and restore Shu. Zhong Hui's own soldiers mutiny and kill them both. Jiang Wei's secret letter to Liu Shan, 'endure a few days' humiliation, I will make the state safe again', is quoted in the notes.
summary_zh: 姜维投降钟会，怂恿他据蜀反叛司马昭，暗中打算事成后杀掉钟会、恢复蜀汉。结果魏军兵变，钟会、姜维都死于乱军之中。姜维给刘禅的密信“愿陛下忍数日之辱，臣欲使社稷危而复安”，见于裴注所引《华阳国志》。

title: 'I am happy here, I do not miss Shu'
summary: At a banquet in Luoyang Sima Zhao has Shu music played; Liu Shan's old officials weep, Liu Shan laughs. Asked whether he misses Shu, he says: I am happy here, I do not miss Shu. The Han-Jin chunqiu records the exchange.
summary_zh: 司马昭在洛阳设宴，命人演奏蜀地乐曲，旧蜀臣都伤心落泪，刘禅却嬉笑自若。司马昭问他是否思念蜀国，刘禅答：“此间乐，不思蜀。”此事见于裴注引《汉晋春秋》。

title: Deng Ai and his son are killed
summary: After Zhong Hui's revolt fails, Deng Ai's men go after the cart to free him; Wei Guan, who had arrested him, sends Tian Xu to kill him and his son on the road.
summary_zh: 钟会之乱平定后，邓艾部下追赶槛车想救回邓艾，监军卫瓘怕他报复，派田续在绵竹以西追杀了邓艾父子。

title: Sima Yan ends Wei and founds Jin
summary: Sima Zhao dies, and his son Sima Yan has the last Wei emperor abdicate to him, on a terrace, after three refusals, exactly as Cao Pi had done to the Han forty-five years before. The novel's chapter title calls it drawing a gourd from the same pattern.
summary_zh: 司马昭死后，其子司马炎逼魏元帝曹奂禅位，筑坛受禅，三辞三让，与四十五年前曹丕代汉如出一辙。小说回目称之为“依样画葫芦”。

title: Sun Hao's cruelty
summary: The last Wu emperor, Sun Hao, drinks, builds palaces, and has ministers' faces flayed and eyes gouged out. Wu's best men are killed or flee, and its people wait for Jin. Recorded in Sun Hao's biography.
summary_zh: 吴国末帝孙皓荒淫残暴，大兴土木，动辄剥人面皮、凿人眼睛。忠臣或被杀或出逃，百姓离心，只等晋军到来。见于《三国志·孙皓传》。

title: Yang Hu and Lu Kang, enemies and friends
summary: The Jin commander Yang Hu and the Wu commander Lu Kang face each other across the border and treat each other with honour: Lu Kang drinks Yang Hu's wine without fear of poison, Yang Hu takes Lu Kang's medicine. Dying, Yang Hu recommends Du Yu to finish the conquest of Wu. The Book of Jin tells it.
summary_zh: 晋将羊祜与吴将陆抗隔境对峙，彼此以礼相待：陆抗饮羊祜送来的酒毫不疑心，羊祜服陆抗送来的药也不怀疑。羊祜临终举荐杜预接替他完成灭吴大业。此事见于《晋书·羊祜传》。

title: Sun Hao surrenders; the three kingdoms become one
summary: Wang Jun reaches Jianye and the last Wu emperor, Sun Hao, comes out bound with his coffin behind him. Ninety-six years after the Yellow Turbans, the realm is one again. The novel ends with its opening thought: the empire, long divided, must unite; long united, must divide.
summary_zh: 王濬楼船抵达建业，吴帝孙皓面缚舆榇出降。自黄巾起义算起九十六年，天下重归一统。小说以开篇那句话收尾：“天下大势，分久必合，合久必分。”

title: Wang Jun's fleet comes down the Yangzi
summary: Wang Jun's great warships, built in Yizhou for seven years, sail down the Yangzi. Wu has chained the gorges with iron and planted iron spikes in the river; Wang Jun sends rafts ahead to catch the spikes and burns through the chains with torches soaked in oil.
summary_zh: 王濬在益州造楼船七年，率水军顺江东下。东吴在江中暗设铁锥、横江拉起铁锁，王濬先放木筏冲走铁锥，再用灌满麻油的火炬烧断铁锁，一路势如破竹。

title: Du Yu takes Jiangling, 'like splitting bamboo'
summary: Du Yu takes Jiangling; when officers urge waiting out the summer floods, he answers that the army's momentum is like splitting bamboo: after the first few joints, the rest open of themselves. The phrase is from his biography in the Book of Jin.
summary_zh: 杜预攻克江陵。有人主张等过了夏季水涨再进兵，杜预说：“今兵威已振，譬如破竹，数节之后，皆迎刃而解。”“势如破竹”一语即出于此，见于《晋书·杜预传》。
